evidence.description: Longest single flight in the operator's timetable, minutes

policy.text: Airfare. Standard economy is allowed. Premium economy is reimbursable only if the longest single scheduled airborne segment lasts at least 360 minutes; connection and total itinerary times do not qualify. Reject a confirmed premium economy itinerary below that segment threshold. Route missing segment evidence for a premium fare to review. Reject business or first class irrespective of duration.

evidence.description: Current bank reconciliation status for that row

policy.text: Duplicate reimbursements. Check the payment reconciliation row for the receipt reference. If the recorded reference matches the current scanned receipt and a previous payment is settled, reject the duplicate. If the matching previous payment is fully reversed or voided, approve. A pending or unreconciled matching payment goes to review. A settled payment for a different receipt does not block approval.

evidence.description: Paid equipment reimbursements in charge's calendar half-year, USD cents
Employee annual screen, including other reimbursements, USD cents

policy.text: Equipment allowance. Add the current USD charge to equipment reimbursements already paid in its calendar half-year. For charges before 2025-07-01 the inclusive cap was USD 300.00; for charges on or after 2025-07-01 it is USD 400.00. Approve if the total fits, reject an overage, and route unavailable half-year payment history to review. An annual total or an estimate from the employee cannot replace that history.

evidence.description: Accounting rate at month end, USD per local unit
Corporate rate on charge date, USD per local unit

policy.text: Foreign travel meal. The cap is USD 60.00 inclusive. Multiply the original expense amount by the corporate purchase-date rate quoted as USD per unit of local currency. Round the result to the nearest USD cent, half cents up. Approve at or below the cap; reject above it. If that date's rate is unavailable, route to review. The month-end reference rate is for accounting only and cannot be substituted.

evidence.description: Destination band in the travel directory
Number of billed nights on booking
Room-only subtotal from folio, USD cents

policy.text: Lodging cap. Use the room-only subtotal in USD cents before taxes, divided by the billed number of nights. In a metro rate zone the nightly cap is USD 220; in a standard zone it is USD 160. Approve rates at or below the cap and reject higher rates. If a required folio or zone field is unavailable, route to review. Ignore taxes, deposits and card totals.

evidence.description: Employee request created in the portal (UTC)

policy.text: Equipment approvals. A purchase above USD 150.00 requires a department manager's recorded authorization strictly before the card charge, compared in UTC. Reject an authorization recorded at or after the charge. If the approval time cannot be verified, route to review. Approve amounts up to USD 150 without preapproval. The employee's request timestamp is never an authorization.
